read: []

create: [src/Main.java]

verify:
  - run: d=$(mktemp -d) && javac -d "$d" src/Main.java && java -cp "$d" Main | grep -qx 'Hello, World!'
    timeout_s: 120
effort: low
budget: { max_usd: 0.1 }
---
## Objective
The repository contains a runnable Java program that prints a greeting, so the project has a minimal working Java entry point.

## Interface
File `src/Main.java` declares `public class Main` with the standard entry point `public static void main(String[] args)`. No package declaration.

## Behavior
1. Running `Main` prints exactly `Hello, World!` followed by a newline to standard output.
2. The program exits with status 0.

## Invariants
Compiles with plain `javac` and no external dependencies or build tool.

## Edge cases
None.

## Guardrails
Do not add build files (Maven, Gradle), tests or other source files. Do not commit compiled `.class` files.

## Out of scope
Build tooling, tests, command-line argument handling.
